release_notes:
Adds full support for Memos server v0.31.

• New: sessions survive v0.31's new 15-minute access tokens — Memosly stores the rotating refresh cookie and renews the token automatically, including after the app was closed overnight.
• New: comments copy their parent memo's visibility and space, so replies stay visible to the same audience as before.
• New: notifications, access tokens, webhooks, identity providers, admin instance info, creator filters and creator names all follow the v0.31 API; user-scoped calls use usernames, which v0.31 requires.
• New: the profile's About section shows which Memos server versions the app supports.

Servers v0.24–v0.26 keep working exactly as before — every v0.31 call site is version-gated. When logging in, select "v0.31" for a v0.31 server.
release_notes_zh:
全面兼容 Memos 服务端 v0.31。

• 新增：适配 v0.31 新的 15 分钟访问令牌 —— Memosly 保存轮换的刷新 Cookie 并自动续期，App 被系统关闭后重新打开也能保持登录。
• 新增：评论会继承所属备忘的可见性和所属空间，回复的可见范围与旧版一致。
• 新增：通知、访问令牌、Webhook、身份验证服务、管理信息、创作者筛选与创作者名称全部适配 v0.31 接口；用户相关调用改用用户名（v0.31 已不再使用数字 ID）。
• 新增：个人资料「关于」区域显示 App 当前支持的 Memos 服务端版本。

v0.24–v0.26 服务端不受影响，所有 v0.31 分支均按服务器版本隔离。登录时对应版本请选择「v0.31」。
